# Ezekiel 1 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 1:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-[the]-likeness-of their-faces: [the]-face-of a-human, and-[the]-face-of a-lion to-the-right to-the-four-of-them, and-[the]-face-of an-ox from-the-left to-the-four-of-them, and-[the]-face-of an-eagle to-the-four-of-them. |
| LOGOS | As for the likeness of their faces, each had the face of a man. The four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and the four had the face of an eagle. |
| PNEUMA | Each had four faces: a human face in front, a lion's face on the right, an ox's face on the left, and an eagle's face at the back. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:14 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-living-creatures were-running and-returning like-[the]-appearance-of the-lightning-flash. |
| LOGOS | And the living creatures darted to and fro, like the appearance of a flash of lightning. |
| PNEUMA | The creatures themselves shot back and forth like bolts of lightning. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:17 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Upon their-four sides in-their-going they-would-go; they-did-not-turn in-their-going. |
| LOGOS | When they went, they went in any of their four directions without turning as they went. |
| PNEUMA | The wheels could go in any of the four directions without the creatures turning as they moved. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:19 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-in-the-going-of the-living-creatures, the-wheels went beside-them; and-in-the-lifting-of the-living-creatures from-upon the-earth, the-wheels were-lifted. |
| LOGOS | And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures rose from the earth, the wheels rose. |
| PNEUMA | When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved with them. When the creatures rose off the ground, the wheels rose too. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:24 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-heard the-sound-of their-wings like-[the]-sound-of many waters, like-[the]-voice-of Shaddai, in-their-going — [the]-sound-of tumult like-[the]-sound-of an-army; in-their-standing they-let-down their-wings. |
| LOGOS | And when they went, I heard the sound of their wings like the sound of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a sound of tumult like the sound of an army. When they stood still, they let down their wings. |
| PNEUMA | When they flew, the sound of their wings was like the roar of rushing water, like the thundering voice of God Almighty, like the noise of a vast army. When they stopped, they lowered their wings. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:16 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-appearance-of the-wheels and-their-workmanship [was] like-[the]-gleam-of beryl, and-one likeness to-the-four-of-them; and-their-appearance and-their-workmanship [was] as-if a-wheel were in-the-midst-of a-wheel. |
| LOGOS | As for the appearance of the wheels and their construction: their appearance was like the gleaming of beryl. And the four had the same likeness, their appearance and construction being as it were a wheel within a wheel. |
| PNEUMA | The wheels sparkled like topaz. All four wheels looked the same — each one was constructed so that it appeared to have a second wheel crossing through the middle of it at right angles. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
